stdout:
PASS 160 verified followers: eight added per tribe, no duplicate identity or accidental effect collision
PASS every token triples across hand and board, preserves buffs and keywords, discovers legal next-tier minions
PASS large token gifts merge repeatedly without burning reward slots or mutating combat summons
PASS tier-one shield knight has 2/2 stats and gains one permanent attack and health per broken shield
PASS spell research buffs only nonzero spell attributes and does not create free coins, shields or resources
PASS research applies once before Merlin spreads the actual boosted payload
PASS research entry is repeatable and golden; cries train both followers and later spells
PASS third-spell research and payoff counters persist through end turn and save/load
PASS combo research, fairy rally and resource-selling connect without generating cards from nothing
PASS high-tier dragons train spells and the brood from actual tavern tier and attack
PASS grave expenditure feeds research or team growth; insufficient grave gives no reward
PASS amulet cultivation and echo scale payloads, but count expiration and copies only once
PASS paid self-harm trains spells and health, even with healing; zero actual damage cannot trigger it
PASS module research has separate shared spell and weapon axes, with a scrap payoff
PASS damage records raw simultaneous hits, shield blocks, injury-growth and overkill without mutating inputs
PASS new combat engines apply equally on both sides and golden deathrattles show inherited bodies
PASS dragon injury mentor, attack trainer and token-death growth create permanent ledgers
PASS AI uses real research cards and persists new counters with no special stats
PASS legacy progress migrates and new corrupted research/replay counters are rejected
19 v7 rules groups passed.

PASS all eight tribes have nineteen or twenty minions, six tiers, two supported main paths and a secondary role
PASS all 70 four-tribe combinations: 82–84 minion pool, every shop tier and freeze refresh stay legal
PASS random pools are seeded, contain no neutral slot, and selected hero belongs to the pool
PASS triple discovery and both random amulets never produce excluded tribes
PASS AI only recruits from the four-tribe pool across all tiers
PASS legacy saves remain playable with their original six tribes
PASS corrupt pool identifiers, counts, progress values and duplicates are rejected
PASS self-damage triggers team growth; one health prevents cost-free payoffs
PASS golden blood fanfare pays its cost once and doubles its reward
PASS every point of cumulative self-damage strengthens the opening formation and survives healing
PASS bats inherit their parent and each death produces a visible full-attack volley
PASS lifesteal requires health damage and can heal beyond six as settlement healing
PASS weapon restrictions reject invalid hand and direct-shop play without spending
PASS every weapon triggers golden adjacent echoes and stronger weapon quality
PASS artifact deaths increment lifetime scrap and reconstruct scaled real tokens
PASS Spinaria rewards original units permanently after more than six allied deaths
PASS scrap is applied once, persists in saves, and powers the next battle
PASS neutral support is not a fifth tribe for menagerie and Bahamut opening growth
PASS one-health blood power does not spend gold; neutral units cannot trigger distinct-tribe rewards
PASS Merlin copies the blood spell payload, not separate self-damage growth triggers
20 pool and new-tribe groups passed.

PASS new games and golden merges contain no evolution state and retain existing bonuses
PASS retired evolve action is rejected without spending or modifying any state
PASS normalization preserves legacy recruit stats, cards, and progress and is idempotent
PASS normalization reaches AI cards, every battle replay frame, and survivors without altering combat
PASS round transitions and AI preparation through round twelve never restore evolution
PASS the old Light path card id now buffs the whole board without a target or energy
PASS Olivia buffs other allies on entry and no longer has a separate end trigger
PASS Olivia remains a useful repeatable royal battlecry without granting evolution resources
PASS initiates give blessing and immediately expire only the lowest countdown amulet
PASS golden initiate applies its full reduction to one surviving target and empty racks remain playable
PASS current rules and normal/golden card descriptions never advertise retired evolution

11 no-evolution regression groups passed.

PASS shield spell is shared by royal and haven pools without opening a fifth follower tribe
PASS flag bearer gives playable shield spells, with golden quantity and correct preview
PASS avenge shields only living other royal allies without shields, normal one / golden two on both sides
PASS replacement shields can break again and trigger knight plus Emilia permanent growth
PASS no-target avenge is a no-op and a dead relay cannot observe simultaneous deaths
PASS relay can replenish multiple times across successive death waves
6 shield support groups passed.

PASS Sammy is a four-star 4/6 sale engine, not a repeatable battlecry
PASS Sammy cannot be bought at tiers one through three; three-star triples may discover it early
PASS Penguin alone retains immediate entry and sale spells; Sammy turns it into a three-spell cycle
PASS all tribes and tokens trigger sales, normal/golden copies stack and no per-round quota exists
PASS self-sale, discard, merge and combat death never fabricate sale rewards
PASS full hands cap generation; invalid sale cannot trigger a resource or spend gold
PASS generated spells really trigger growth, combo and research without counting generation as casts
PASS alchemist produces three/six casts; dessert wizard produces two/four dual-stat spells
PASS AI retains a useful Sammy and plays its sale-generated spells during recruitment
9 spell-economy groups passed.

PASS four deterministic unique eligible offers; all six flexible heroes can occur with every pool
PASS all heroes and seven AI start with assigned armor; neutral never occupies a tribe slot
PASS neutral powers pay real costs, work across tribes, persist gains and cannot be reused
PASS invalid hero targeting or empty wind board does not consume gold or activation
PASS armor absorbs repeated losses, overflows to health and cannot prevent lethal after depletion
PASS real player loss and real AI loss use armor and expose exact result breakdown
PASS AI-vs-AI damage also consumes armor rather than health
PASS blood purchase self-harm bypasses armor and healing does not refill it
PASS fatigue bypasses armor on player and AI
PASS legacy saves start at zero armor, depleted saves never refill, malformed values are rejected
PASS AI retains each flexible hero and spent armor across recruitment and uses its power

11 hero draft and armor groups passed.
